say:2:1330439001:1.text: Take it easy. At least we can finally get out of here now, right?
say:2:1330439001:1.source_cn: 放松些，至少现在我们终于可以离开这里了，不是吗？

say:3:1330439002:1.text: Nothing! It was a complete waste of time!
say:3:1330439002:1.source_cn: 完全没有！经过了这么多天的寻找，我们得出的唯一结论就是...
say:3:1330439002:1.male: Nothing! It was a complete waste of time!
say:3:1330439002:1.female: Nothing! It was a complete waste of time!

say:4:1330439003:1.text: Can't believe we couldn't find anything valuable in such a large site.
say:4:1330439003:1.source_cn: 真不敢相信，这么大的遗址里却找不到一件有价值的东西。
say:4:1330439003:1.male: Can't believe we couldn't find anything valuable in such a large site.
say:4:1330439003:1.female: Can't believe we couldn't find anything valuable in such a large site.
